services.name: claims.v1.ClaimsService
services.doc:
ClaimsService provides daily campaign rewards. It accepts a session token, or an API key
 scoped to the main account whose policy grants the call's account permission.

methods.name: ClaimDailyReward
methods.summary: Claim today's reward once for the authenticated root account, paid to the root account or to a subaccount it owns. All reward assets are transferred together, and retries return the same claim.
methods.doc:

 An API key needs CLAIM_DAILY_REWARD and must be scoped to the main account.

methods.name: GetDailyClaimStatus
methods.summary: Get today's reward and claim status for the authenticated root account. Future reward schedules are not returned.
